name: 30-day Trial Lifecycle (Activation → Reminders → Conversion)
description: End-to-end lifecycle for the Business-equivalent 30-day trial, including activation rules, entitlement gating, reminder schedule, conversion to paid plans, grace periods, and billing-safe state transitions.
goals: Consistent and auditable trial state machine per workspace.
Prevent revenue leakage: enforce entitlements at API boundary, not only UI.
Ensure idempotent billing operations and safe retries for webhooks/jobs.
Provide clear UX for remaining days, upgrade path, and downgrade/cancel handling.
nonGoals: Complex A/B experimentation framework for trial rules (can be added later).
Multi-seat invoicing engine beyond what subscriptions/invoicing already cover (see payments_billing_subscriptions).

rules: Trial state is strictly workspace-scoped and must be enforced for every gated action.
All trial/billing events must include workspace_id for attribution and audit.
No trial state is derived from client-provided claims; it is always server-authoritative.

actors.name: Workspace Owner
actors.description: Starts trial, upgrades/downgrades plans, updates billing settings.

actors.name: Workspace Admin
actors.description: May manage plan settings if allowed by RBAC.

actors.name: Platform Admin
actors.description: Handles payment disputes, fraud, edge cases.

actors.name: System
actors.description: Trial scheduler, entitlement enforcer, notification dispatcher.

workflows.name: Activate Trial on Signup
steps: Create workspace with status=active and default language.
Create WorkspaceSubscription with status=trialing and set trial_started_at/trial_expires_at (30 days).
Generate entitlement snapshot for Business-equivalent trial.
Emit event trial.started and schedule reminders.
Expose remaining days + upgrade CTA via API.

workflows.name: Trial Reminder Cadence
steps: Daily job computes days_remaining for all trialing workspaces.
Send reminders at configurable milestones (e.g., day 1, 7, 14, 23, 27, 29).
Do not spam: respect per-workspace notification settings and per-user preferences.
Log every notification attempt and outcome.

workflows.name: Expiry + Grace + Restriction
steps: At trial_expires_at, mark subscription past_due unless upgraded.
Apply grace period window for read-only access if configured.
Enforce entitlements: block creation of new galleries/uploads if not allowed.
Allow export/download of owned data per retention policy.

controls: RBAC: only workspace_owner/admin can change plan/billing settings.
Webhook signature verification and replay protection (dedupe by provider_event_id).
Server-authoritative subscription status; no client-controlled gating.
Audit log: trial start, upgrade, cancel, webhook processing outcomes.

alerts: High trial expiry without reminders (scheduler failure)
Repeated entitlement-denied errors for active subscribers (misconfig)

acceptanceTests: A new workspace enters trialing status with trial_expires_at exactly 30 days after activation.
Entitlements are enforced at API boundary for trial-expired workspaces.
Billing webhooks are idempotent: duplicate provider_event_id does not double-apply changes.
Upgrade moves workspace to active and recomputes entitlements within one minute.
